messages:
anna_ml: Heads up — bringing up Apollo-13b (int4) on canary today. Initial perf looks fine but we hit a few cold-start OOMs on 1/10 runs when max_new_tokens=512.
rob_serving: Seen similar with other 13b-int4 variants — fragmentation + KV prefetch combined is the usual suspect. Can you paste the runtime config?
anna_ml: Config snippet:
```
model: apollo-13b-int4
prefetch_kv: true
kv_trim_threshold_bytes: 0
batching: { max_batch_tokens: 4096, max_batch_size: 8 }
defaults: { max_new_tokens: 512 }
```
anna_ml: OOM trace: "AllocFailure: failed to allocate 512MB during kv cache growth" — only at cold start after a long idle period.
kai_infra: Try turning prefetch_kv off for canary and set kv_trim_threshold_bytes=64MB to force early trimming. Also lower max_new_tokens default to 128 for hosted tier.
maria_research: Note: we ran evals with 128 and saw a tiny quality delta on conversational prompts (0.6% drop on BLEU-like metric). Might be okay; need to track regressions per prompt set.
rob_serving: Plan: patch runtime defaults for this model on canary: prefetch_kv=false, kv_trim_threshold_bytes=67108864, defaults.max_new_tokens=128, and reduce max_batch_size to 6 for int4. Then monitor memory spikes + error rate.
anna_ml: Doing canary deploy now. deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for apollo-13b-int4 on cluster-phi (2 nodes).
anna_ml: After 10 minutes: 0 OOMs so far but a few slow cold starts (+120ms).
kai_infra: If cold-start latency unacceptable we can warm the KV cache via lightweight priming requests at init. Suggest endpoint warmup script: `for i in 1..20: curl /generate?prompt=ping`
maria_research: I'll re-run the quality evals with the canary config and share per-prompt diffs in the next thread. If regression >1% on core prompts we fallback to int8 canary.
rob_serving: Agreed. If canary stays stable for 30m we roll to dedicated pool with same kv_trim and defaults. Otherwise revert. :thumbsup:
anna_ml: Thanks all — logging results to the model-onboard board.
